identification: Eight Australian 1966 round 50 cent coins (Coat of Arms reverse, one-year type, 80% silver, 13.28 g, 10.62 g fine silver each, 85.0 g fine in total). Photo shows two obverses (one with 1966 date clear, Machin portrait) and six reverses. Bright lustrous surfaces, grade by photo about EF to aUNC with normal bag marks; no holders. Lot page: estimate A$120-170, current bid A$90.
